# Bizagi Receives $48 Million Investment From Invus

WSJ Pro

Sept. 13, 2017 1:02 pm ET

[Comments Button](https://www.wsj.com/articles/bizagi-receives-48-million-investment-from-invus-1505322164#comments_sector)

Bizagi Ltd., an enterprise software company, said it closed a $48 million minority investment by Invus Group.

The U.K. company said in a news release it will use the capital to accelerate expansion efforts across focus markets, namely the U.S. and Europe.
